Greetings, all! As a relatively new contributor, I thought I'd draw a bit of attention to my new PR removing a superfluous hypothesis in IsTheta.rpow. All automated checks have passed.

I just noticed my title does not include a typical opening classifier like "feat(Analysis)". May I add it, or is that for the maintainers to decide?
You need to add that classifier, and in fact a CI check should fail if you don't, but it was skipped. That's odd
